narratives.Overview:
## Parent

#4164

## Locked design

https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4164 is the bound contract (successor lean 5573709507). This child implements the release-input module (decisions 6-11, 13-14, the lone-LF rule, budgets, and enumeration/diagnostics). Bind-time amendment for finding 4164-distilled-claude-F1: a committed newline/tab/control-bearing filename must not forge a `[release-input]` detail line or a step-status `OK (...)` / `FAIL (...)` line. Do not recut the parent body.

## What to build

Add one release-input module and run it twice: full structural, size-budget, and provenance validation before the native Step 3 scanner or issue-state fetch, then an independent full validation after CI immediately before ROADMAP preparation. Both native readers consume bounded, regular, committed lifecycle inputs. Disk equals HEAD except the parent lone-LF expansion. `--allow-dirty` and `--allow-vbrief-drift` bypass neither phase.

## Acceptance criteria

Parent #4164 sections **Inputs and production coupling** and **Content relation**, plus:

- [ ] Missing canonical root is `missing-lifecycle-root` / `EXIT_VIOLATION`, never an empty census. Legacy-only stays the migration refusal with no legacy traversal.
- [ ] Production-reader observer tests prove five scanner folders including `cancelled/` and four ROADMAP folders excluding it.
- [ ] Ignored/untracked regular candidates are refused before the real scanner seam, including `status.showUntrackedFiles=no` and an ignored `*.premigrate.xbrief.json`.
- [ ] 1 MiB per-file and 64 MiB per-view limits accept the exact boundary and refuse boundary+1, including one real 64 MiB streaming `cat-file` fixture. Distinct invalid-UTF-8 blob buffers stay unequal.
- [ ] A CI seam changing a final ROADMAP candidate is caught after CI. Early provenance is not reused.
- [ ] Lone-LF expansion matches the parent byte relation. `HEAD=CRLF / disk=CRCRLF` and `HEAD=CRLF / disk=LF` fail.
- [ ] Escaped single-line path displays. A committed newline-bearing filename cannot forge a `[release-input]` detail line or a step-status OK/FAIL line.
- [ ] All new tests pass.
- [ ] `task check` passes.

## Type

AFK

## Blocked by

- Blocked by #4316

## File scope (advisory)

New module under `packages/core/src/release/` (name TBD; not present on `origin/master`). Wire into `packages/core/src/release/pipeline.ts` and `packages/core/src/release/native-steps.ts`. Reuse Buffer/NUL machinery from `packages/core/src/release/build-dist.ts` only with strict framing. Do not reuse `showBlobsBatch` / `parseGitCatFileBatch`. Do not inherit `loadVbriefs` catch-and-return-empty. Do not call `resolveLifecycleRoot` before the canonical-root `lstat` guard.

items.title: Five-folder validation lives in pipeline.ts after Step 2 and before if (config.allowVbriefDrift). Not inside checkVbriefLifecycleSyncNative. --allow-dirty and --allow-vbrief-drift bypass neither phase. Dry-run does not run the new Git probes. The non-dry-run path still validates when mismatch policy is skipped. The Step 3 SKIP line must not claim the whole step was skipped after provenance ran.
Phase 2 is the same module, second independent census, after Step 5 (including --skip-ci and suite-stamp skip) and before current Step 6 writeFile of CHANGELOG.
Wave 2 still implements parent #4164 decisions 6-11, 13-14, lone-LF, budgets, and enumeration/diagnostics. This recut is hook sites only.

At each phase the census is the three-view union. The filesystem view is gitignore-blind raw-name readdir plus lstat. Neither porcelain nor git ls-files --others --exclude-standard is that view. Ignored/untracked regular candidates are refused before the real scanner/render seams.

Escaped single-line applies to existing Step 3 mismatch reason paths and any other path-bearing stderr this child writes in pipeline.ts / native-steps.ts, and to new [release-input] / OK/FAIL displays. Do not route those details through emit() or raw process.stderr.write(reason).

Reuse splitGitLsFilesZRecords / GIT_LS_FILES_Z_ENCODING with strict framing. Do not reuse showBlobsBatch / parseGitCatFileBatch, listGitTrackedPathRecords --git-dir=.git, loadVbriefs catch-and-return-empty, or resolveLifecycleRoot before a non-following lstat of lexical xbrief/.
Do not recut the parent #4164 body.

## Gate stamp

The triage author stamps the semantic call. P1 is native release readers consuming uncommitted, unbounded, or non-regular lifecycle inputs, dirty-tree flags skipping provenance, and a committed control-bearing filename forging a [release-input] or step-status line. Open critique of #4317. Fresh critic. Ceiling comment 5714680330. Dispatch SHA `068831ea6b68afde722b2bfc2899f6ab87f880db`.

Re-measured the issue body: 2708 UTF-8 bytes, SHA-256 `0a6fda5178819716fb29d1a06918a685f861f36292aed6596cda88377223a63e` (matches the write-back). Parent bound record is successor lean 5573709507. No comment after the ceiling was read.

The child can bind after two call-site sentences. No `blocks-the-design` finding.

## 4317-grok-F1 — Step 3 skip envelope (`sharpens-framing`)

Evidence. On this SHA, `runPipeline` Step 3 is:

- `allowVbriefDrift` → emit `SKIP (--allow-vbrief-drift)` and do not call `checkVbriefFn`
- else `dryRun` → emit DRYRUN and do not call it
- else call `seams.checkVbriefLifecycleSync` / `checkVbriefLifecycleSyncNative`

The native function starts with `resolveLifecycleRoot` (`statSync`, follows symlinks, then recursive `containsMigratedArtifact`), then `scanLifecycleAnchors`, then `fetchIssueStatesForRelease`. Step 1 `checkGitClean` is `git status --porcelain` with no `-uall` / `--ignored`. `--allow-dirty` only WARNs on that porcelain and continues. `RELEASE_HELP` still says `--allow-vbrief-drift` bypasses "the vBRIEF-lifecycle sync pre-flight gate". Pipeline fixtures default `allowVbriefDrift: true`.

The child already says those flags bypass neither phase. Bound parent order puts five-folder validation inside Step 3 *before* the mismatch-skip branch. Child file-scope still says "wire into `native-steps.ts`".

Failure mode. An AFK land that places the new module inside `checkVbriefLifecycleSyncNative` (or behind that `if`) lets `--allow-vbrief-drift` and the injected Step 3 seam skip provenance. Ignored / untracked / symlink / control-bearing lifecycle names then reach the real scanner, or never get gated. That is the P1 the write-back named. Putting the call fully outside *every* Step 3 branch, including dry-run, starts Git probes on `--dry-run`, which the bound parent forbids until Wave 3.

Disposition. Name the live hooks in `pipeline.ts`:

1. Five-folder validation after Step 2 and before `if (config.allowVbriefDrift)`. Not inside `checkVbriefLifecycleSyncNative`.
2. Dry-run does not run the new Git probes. Decision 12 wording stays Wave 3. The non-dry-run path still validates when mismatch policy is skipped.
3. The Step 3 SKIP line must not claim the whole step was skipped after provenance ran.

The child binds with those sentences. Do not recut the parent body.

## 4317-grok-F2 — phase-2 hook is pre-write (`sharpens-framing`)

Evidence. On this SHA, non-dry-run Step 6 does `writeFile(changelogPath, promotedChangelog)`, then Step 7 calls `refreshRoadmapFn` → `refreshRoadmapNative` → `renderRoadmap` (write). Decision 13 is in this child's list: a pre-write input refusal did not promote CHANGELOG or write ROADMAP. Bound parent puts four-folder validation inside the future Step 6 prepare, before any artifact write. Wave 3 is blocked by this child, so that prepare step does not exist yet. Child text "after CI immediately before ROADMAP preparation" reads as current Step 7 against today's labels.

Failure mode. Phase 2 inside `refreshRoadmapNative`, or immediately before current Step 7, runs after CHANGELOG already gained a version heading. A late four-folder refusal cannot honestly say the artifact phase did not promote CHANGELOG. The `refreshRoadmap` seam would also skip the guard. Same-version retry is no longer a clean pre-write refusal.

Disposition. Name the live phase-2 hook as after Step 5 (including `--skip-ci` and suite-stamp skip) and before current Step 6 `writeFile` of CHANGELOG. Same module, second independent census. Wave 3 moves that call into prepare-then-write. Contiguity with in-memory ROADMAP render is Wave 3; Wave 2 is the refuse-without-mutate seam plus the post-CI independence AC.

## 4317-grok-F3 — do not reuse `emit()` for unescaped details (`footnote`)

Measured: Step 1 already does `emit(..., "WARN (dirty, --allow-dirty set):\n${output}")`, so porcelain rides after an embedded newline. No path-escape helper exists under `packages/core/src/release/`. Child extra AC already requires escaped single-line `[release-input]` / OK/FAIL displays. Do not route those details through `emit()` or raw `process.stderr.write(reason)`.

## Existing mechanisms (inventory)

Reuse, do not clone:

- `splitGitLsFilesZRecords` / `GIT_LS_FILES_Z_ENCODING` in `build-dist.ts` (NUL records). Strict framing only.
- `LIFECYCLE_FOLDERS` + `hasArtifactSuffix` as the Step 3 census; `renderRoadmapToBuffer` (`pending` / `active` / `proposed` / `completed`) as the ROADMAP census.
- Release `runGit` / `git -C <projectRoot>` for linked worktrees.

Do not reuse:

- `showBlobsBatch` / `parseGitCatFileBatch` (newline-joined `cat-file` stdin, UTF-8 decode, 64 MiB `maxBuffer` including framing, per-path `git show` fallback).
- `listGitTrackedPathRecords` (`--git-dir=.git --work-tree=.`).
- `loadVbriefs` catch-and-return-empty / skip-invalid-JSON.
- `resolveLifecycleRoot` / `resolveLifecycleFolder` / `existsSync` before a non-following `lstat` of the lexical `xbrief/` root.
- `checkGitClean` as a substitute for the three-view predicate.

## Injection / swarm lens

This child changes release authority, untrusted lifecycle bytes/names, and shared CHANGELOG/ROADMAP state.

- Authority: `--allow-vbrief-drift` and `--allow-dirty` are live bypasses of the current Step 3 / Step 1 envelopes (F1). A SKIP line after provenance has run is a false authority signal.
- Untrusted names: a POSIX filename can hold newline/tab/control, not `/`. `showBlobsBatch` stdin and `emit()`/`reason` lines are the forge surfaces. Bound F1 amendment plus parent Enumeration 102 already require escaped single-line diagnostics; the skip envelope is what would skip that gate.
- Untrusted nodes: `statSync`/`existsSync` follow a symlink `xbrief/` and `containsMigratedArtifact` walks the target. Parent Inputs require zero target-directory reads before refusal. The new module's `lstat` must be first, including on the `--allow-vbrief-drift` path.
- Shared artifacts: phase 2 after the current CHANGELOG write (F2) mutates a shared release file under a claimed pre-write refusal.
- Worktrees: archive `--git-dir=.git` is wrong for a `.git` file. Stay on `git -C`.
- Concurrency: Decision 14 adds no lock. Do not reopen that.

GitHub issue-state fetch stays after provenance. Provenance is not content trust. Not a new hole if the census is committed, regular, and bounded.

## Road-not-taken

Rejected shipping the module unwired. Child AC requires the real scanner seam and a post-CI four-folder refusal.

Rejected folding phase 1 into `checkVbriefLifecycleSyncNative`. Steelman: one function, and dry-run would skip Git probes for free because that function is already behind the dry-run branch. Flip: only if pipeline first recut `--allow-vbrief-drift` to skip mismatch *after* a pipeline-level guard. That recut is not present on this SHA, so the steelman fails on the live skip.

No new mechanism. The missing text is where the existing module runs relative to the existing skip and write sites.

## 4317-pain-P1-F1 — Spec-path harvest omits the three-view census (`sharpens-framing`)

Evidence. Stop 1 P1 includes native readers consuming uncommitted, unbounded, or non-regular inputs. On this SHA:

- `loadVbriefs` does `readdirSync`, catch-and-return-empty, and skip-invalid-JSON.

It does not name the union of gitignore-blind filesystem `readdir`+`lstat`, index, and HEAD. It does not say porcelain / `ls-files --others` is not the filesystem view. It does not restate ignored/untracked refuse, size budgets, lone-LF, or regular-leaf.

"Do not recut the parent #4164 body" forbids editing #4164. It is not a plan item that implements decisions 6-11 on this child.

Failure mode. An AFK land treats `ls-files -z` as the census because Bound-remedy says to reuse it. Ignored and untracked `*.xbrief.json` (including `status.showUntrackedFiles=no` and ignored `*.premigrate.xbrief.json`) never enter the validator. Step 1 porcelain does not see them. `--allow-dirty` is irrelevant. `scanLifecycleAnchors` and `loadVbriefs` still readdir them. That is P1 conjunct 1.

At each phase the census is the three-view union; the filesystem view is gitignore-blind raw-name `readdir` plus `lstat`; neither porcelain nor `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` is that view; ignored/untracked regular candidates are refused before the real scanner/render seams. Until those sentences are on the harvest, `relieves: P1` overclaims conjunct 1. The hook placement stays.

## 4317-pain-P1-F2 — committed names still forge via Step 3 reason (`sharpens-framing`)

Evidence. P1 conjunct 3 is a committed control-bearing filename forging a `[release-input]` or step-status line. After a provenance pass, `checkVbriefLifecycleSyncNative` still builds `reason` from raw `rel` paths (`native-steps.ts` 87-89) and `runPipeline` does `process.stderr.write(`${reason}\n`)` (`pipeline.ts` 186). `emit` writes `[${step}/13] ${label}... ${status}\n` (`pipeline.ts` 112-113). POSIX filenames may hold newline. Bound-remedy requires escaped single-line `[release-input]` / OK/FAIL displays and says not to route "those details" through `emit()` or raw `process.stderr.write(reason)`. "Those details" can be read as the new module only.

Failure mode. A committed newline-bearing lifecycle name passes the three-view gate, then the live Step 3 mismatch dump writes a raw path. The next stderr line can impersonate `[3/13] ... OK (no mismatches)` or `[release-input]`. That is the #4164 bind-time amendment this child owns. Provenance does not close it.

Disposition. Bound-remedy must say escaped single-line applies to the existing Step 3 mismatch `reason` paths (and any other path-bearing stderr this child writes in `pipeline.ts` / `native-steps.ts`), not only new `[release-input]` details. Keep the new details off `emit()` and raw `stderr.write(reason)`.

Parent #4164 decision 12 skips both input-validation phases on dry-run. Dry-run does not reach the native readers, so this is not a remaining consume hole.
